prompt: Shape the prescribed stretch of as-jpn-tokyo-jr-shape-rect (orig) into the shape the city prescribes (square) with the LLM shape chain.

transcript.note: Angle-preserving radial warp about the ring centre, applied to all 95 vertices in one batch. Target square = shortest side of the Yamanote ring bbox (59), centred on it: x[16,75] y[13,72], O=(45.5,42.5). For every vertex the ray angle from O is kept and only the radius is rescaled — inside the ring |p-O| is scaled by d_square/d_ring, outside the ring [d_ring, canvas edge] is mapped linearly onto [d_square, canvas edge]. Keeping the angle is what makes the whole thing land in one batch: the 360-degree winding order around O is preserved by construction and inside stays inside, outside stays outside. The 23 ring stations then fall naturally on the four sides (6 bottom / 6 right / 7 top / 4 left), each snapped to that side's exact col or row so every side is collinear; the four corner cells are left free and closed with four corner control points (BR 24-46, TR 55-40, TL 35-85, BL 26-53), so no ring station has to be dragged onto a corner. Two extra disciplines fixed what the raw warp broke: (1) strict separation — interior vertices clamped to x[17,74] y[14,71] and exterior vertices pushed strictly outside, because rounding put 13 and 36 exactly on the bottom side line (point-on-segment); (2) corner-chord rule — an exterior vertex adjacent to a ring station on side S must stay in the outer half-plane of S, so 56 (adjacent to 24 on the bottom and 46/47 on the right) moved to the BR outer quadrant (78,10) and 69 (adjacent to 40 on the top) moved above the top side to (81,73); without that their straight chords cut across the corners and crossed the box sides.
transcript.noteZh: 以環中心為心的保角度徑向 warp，一次整批送出全部 95 個頂點。目標正方取山手線環外接框的短邊 59、置中於環：x[16,75] y[13,72]，O=(45.5,42.5)。每個頂點對 O 的射線角度不變、只重新縮放半徑（環內按 d_方/d_環 等比，環外把 [d_環, 畫布邊界] 線性映到 [d_方, 畫布邊界]）——角度不變正是能一輪 batch 的關鍵：繞 O 的 360 度環繞序天生保住，環內恆內、環外恆外。23 個環站因此自然落到四邊（下 6／右 6／上 7／左 4），同邊者一律吸到該邊的同一 col 或 row 使四邊共線；四個角格留空、改用四個轉角控制點收角（BR 24-46、TR 55-40、TL 35-85、BL 26-53），環站只要滑到最近的邊、不必被拉到角上。另加兩層紀律修掉原始 warp 的破口：①嚴格內外分離——環內夾進 x[17,74] y[14,71]、環外一律推到框外，因為取整讓 13 與 36 正好壓在下邊線上（點壓線）；②轉角弦規則——環外點若鄰接某邊上的環站，必須待在該邊的外半平面，於是 56（鄰接下邊的 24 與右邊的 46/47）搬到 BR 角外象限 (78,10)、69（鄰接上邊的 40）搬到上邊之上 (81,73)，否則它們的直線弦會切過轉角、穿過方框的邊。
